children: announced that it is bringing the Allsup's brand to Arizona for the first time and expanding the company's operating footprint into its 10th state.
With the opening of the Willcox location on October 2, Yesway
will operate 453 stores across 10 states, further strengthening the company's presence across the Southwest and reinforcing its position as a leading U.S. convenience retailer.

sees its first investment in Arizona as the beginning of a meaningful and growing presence in the state. Arizona was noted to be an important component of Yesway's broader new-store development strategy, which is currently concentrated in Arizona, Oklahoma, New Mexico, and Texas. The company views Arizona as a natural extension of its existing Southwestern footprint and an especially attractive market for future growth, given the state's expanding communities, favorable fuel market dynamics, significant development opportunities, and strong fit with the Allsup's brand and foodservice offering.

"Opening our first Allsup's store in Arizona is an exceptionally exciting moment for our company and one of the most significant milestones in Yesway's history since we founded the company in 2015," stated Yesway

CEO Tom Trkla. "Arizona is a natural extension of our existing footprint, and we believe the Allsup's operating model is particularly well suited to the state's rural and suburban communities," he added.
The company's entry into Arizona comes as Yesway
continues to execute a disciplined new-store development strategy across its core and adjacent markets. Yesway

has developed and opened more than 90 new-to-industry stores over approximately the past five years, complementing its growth through strategic acquisitions and continued investment in its existing store base.
were down 0.8% in Thursday morning trading to $19.73. The IPO was priced at $20 per share on April 22 and has traded as high as $29.08.

title: Yesway will enter its 10th state with a new store set to open in Arizona
